about_1.en: I pair an economist's analytical training with hands-on industry delivery. At Xinhua News Agency's data arm I independently produced country-industry research, built the underlying database of a country risk product, and developed product pages with AI assistance — learning to move between a dataset, a client-facing deliverable, and a code pipeline.
about_1.zh: 我兼具经济学的分析训练与产业一线的交付经验：在新华社旗下机构独立完成国别产业研究、按既定指标体系搭建国别风险评估产品底层数据库，并用 AI 辅助完成产品页面开发——习惯在数据集、面向客户的交付物与代码管线之间快速切换。
